name: start-floor-rate
description: Calculates your floor rate from your own records, with the fully loaded monthly cost, your real billable days after selling and admin time, the floor per day and per hour, and what moves the floor most, marked internal. Use for "run start-floor-rate", "what is my minimum day rate", "what should my day rate be", "what do I charge", "turn my old salary into a day rate", "lowest price I can quote", "work out my break-even rate", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
